entry.description: Guard, Snap: -{mitigation} damage; for {rounds}, a single-target attack cannot find you in a round you moved; leaves Soot Smoke on the 3x3 around you.
Assault, Heavy: {name}, {power} power, {stagger} stagger; breaks a windup outright (not an unbreakable one), exposes and knocks the target back 2 tiles.
